task_metadata.task_name: Isolated UI Module with Abstract Panels, DI Service, Resource Loader, Stack, and KeepAlive Cache

execution_policy.review_gate_rule: After each implemented step with repository changes, request reviewer approval and do not commit until explicit approval is received.
execution_policy.commit_rule: Single scoped commit is allowed only after reviewer approval.

steps.description: Reasoning pass: lock API boundaries and validate architecture constraints before code changes.

model_config.system_instruction: Perform architecture reasoning only. Define stable contracts and extension points for UI module.

nuances: PanelId generated from panel type, no manual ids.
Design with future cache-limit strategy extension.

steps.description: Create UI module folder structure and core contracts: IUIService, IUIPanel, IResourceLoader, panel config types, cache policy enum, and close semantics.

model_config.system_instruction: Implement Unity C# contracts for DI-first isolated UI architecture.

nuances: No XML comments for public interfaces.
Contracts must avoid coupling to concrete loaders.

steps.description: Implement AbstractUIPanel base class with generated PanelId, base config, lifecycle hooks, and clean enable/disable flow.

model_config.system_instruction: Build extensible abstract panel runtime with strict lifecycle boundaries.

nuances: Support modal and non-modal flags in base config.
No direct resource/service internals in panel base.

steps.description: Implement resource abstraction: IResourceLoader + Resources loader + Addressables loader path (stub or real based on project setup), including release flow.

model_config.system_instruction: Implement swappable resource-loading backend for UI runtime instances.

nuances: UI service depends only on abstraction.
Release semantics must support destroy and keepalive paths.

steps.description: Implement panel registry/factory: type-based registration, generated PanelId resolution, and runtime instantiation pipeline.

model_config.system_instruction: Create robust, low-overhead panel creation and lookup mechanism.

nuances: O(1) lookups for open/close path.
Prevent accidental duplicate active instances.

steps.description: Implement UIService core: Open/Close/CloseAll/CloseTop/IsOpen/TryGet; unified stack for all windows; keepalive cache; IDisposable cleanup.

model_config.system_instruction: Implement deterministic and optimized UI orchestration service.

nuances: Esc behavior maps to CloseAll and gameplay return.
KeepAlive panels hidden and cached without destroy.

steps.description: Implement input gating integration for UI flow and restore on CloseAll. Wire esc-close behavior through service entrypoint.

model_config.system_instruction: Integrate UI lifecycle with input state control via DI boundaries.

nuances: Idempotent restore path required.
No stuck blocked-input states after exceptions/dispose.

steps.description: Create Zenject UIInstaller bindings for service, loaders, registry, factory, and lifecycle/disposal integration.

model_config.system_instruction: Bind full UI module in Zenject with clear ownership and cleanup.

nuances: Preserve existing input installer behavior.
Allow backend loader switch by binding replacement.

steps.description: Migrate 3 target windows to new module: GuideStory, WinScreen, InteractionHint, and route interactions through IUIService.

model_config.system_instruction: Perform safe incremental migration while preserving runtime UX.

nuances: Single stack path for all windows, including hint panel.
Minimize scene wiring breakage during migration.

steps.description: Add/adjust tests for stack ordering, CloseAll, keepalive reuse, loader release flow, and service dispose cleanup.

model_config.system_instruction: Validate critical invariants and regression-risk behaviors for new UI architecture.

nuances: Include repeated open/close loop checks for leaks.
Cover mixed modal/non-modal sequences.

steps.description: Create/update worklog using template under Assets/.cursor/docs/worklogs/, request final review, and only then finalize one scoped commit with allowed prefix.

model_config.system_instruction: Document implementation traceability and finalize repository state.

nuances: If Assets/.cursor docs path is missing, create it before writing worklog.
Exactly one commit for this scoped task.
Commit only after explicit reviewer approval.

unresolved_questions: PanelId runtime key format: string full type name or int hash derived from type.
CloseAll behavior for KeepAlive windows: hide+cache confirmed, no forced destroy.
Esc binding source: dedicated action in MainInput or existing cancel action.
